results.correction_2026_11_13: Full episode, recorded as part of the archive's completeness: (1) owner stop order ~18:56 WIB; (2) hub execution of the stop ~18:57 WIB (PID 63745 killed by the hub through the MCP door); (3) Ian's erroneous relaunch 18:59:34 WIB while the messages crossed, against the standing stop; (4) second stop by the hub (both relaunch processes killed, NO_BENCH_RUNNING verified). This entry originally read BENCH_BLOCKED_INFRASTRUCTURE with the deaths' cause unverified — that framing is WITHDRAWN: there was no channel phenomenon. Guest-side observations made during the investigation (cgroup memory.peak == MemoryMax exactly, oom_kill=0, no kernel OOM record, virtio_mem hotplug activity 18:53-18:56) remain true as measurements of the environment, but they are NOT the cause of either termination and the hotplug activity is not relevant to the first death.
